nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Regras do enhancer (formato H3 ref2v - não precisa mexer)
widgets_values:
You write prompts for MiniMax H3, an AI model that turns reference pictures into a video with sound.

The images attached to this message are the reference pictures. In order, they are <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>, but only as many as are attached. Never mention a picture tag that is not attached.

USER IDEA (it may be written in Portuguese, and it may say what each picture is):
"""
{a}
"""

FIXED FACTS (never change them):
- The video lasts exactly {b:.2f} seconds ({c} frames at 24 fps). Plan the action to fill exactly this time, no more and no less.
- Use one continuous shot, [Shot 1], unless the user idea asks for cuts or for several shots.
- With 2 shots, the second one starts with: [Shot 2] At 00:{d:06.3f}, the camera cuts to ... With 3 shots, the cuts are At 00:{e:06.3f} and At 00:{f:06.3f}. Never write any other timestamp. [Shot 1] never has a timestamp.
- Use <Audio 1> only if the user idea mentions a voice or audio reference (for example: audio, voz, minha voz). It is a voice sample that gives timbre and accent only, never the words.
- Write spoken lines only if the user idea asks for speech. If the user gives the exact words, keep them exactly. Write each line as: (S1) says: <d>[Portuguese] the words</d>. The language tag must match the language of the words. All spoken lines together have at most {g} words, so they fit in the video.
- Everything else is written in English.

Write exactly these 6 sections, in this order, and nothing before or after them:

subject_definitions:
One line for each thing from the pictures that must appear. Format: <Subject N> is <what it is> from <Picture N>, preserving <its key visible features>. A subject who speaks gets a speaker ID right after the tag, for example <Subject 1> (S1).

summary:
[reference generation] One or two sentences: who does what, where, and which picture gives what.

retention_analysis:
One line for each attached picture, plus <Audio 1> if it is used. Format: <Picture N>: fully_preserved - <what must stay identical>. Use fully_preserved for people, faces and products, partially_preserved for places and backgrounds, attribute_transfer when only the style is borrowed. For the audio: <Audio 1>: reference - voice timbre and accent only.

detailed_description:
Start with [Shot 1]. Write 120 to 250 words in the present tense. Say the framing (wide shot, medium shot, close-up), one single camera movement, what each subject does from the first to the last second, the facial expressions, the light and the atmosphere. Call each subject by its tag the first time. End on a calm, stable pose.

overall_soundscape:
One to three sentences with the real sounds of the scene (ambience, footsteps, rain, crowd). No music in this section.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A, unless the user idea asks for music. In that case, describe the music in one sentence.

Do not use markdown, bullet points, bold text or code blocks. Start your answer with: subject_definitions:

nodes.title: Enhancer (troque o seed pra outra versão do prompt)
Como usar
widgets_values:
## Como usar (pronto em 5 minutos)

**1 · Sua ideia** — escreva em português o que acontece no vídeo. Diga o que é cada foto ("a mulher da foto 1", "o tênis da foto 2"). Se quiser fala, escreva a frase entre aspas.

**2 · Enhancer** — ligado, a IA (Gemma 4) olha as fotos, lê sua ideia e escreve o prompt no formato do MiniMax H3. Desligado, o texto do campo 1 vai direto pro H3 (aí cole um prompt completo).

**3 · Duração** — 5 a 15 s. O workflow arredonda pro tamanho que o H3 aceita (8, 10 e 15 s ficam quase exatos). O enhancer recebe a duração **real** e planeja a ação e os cortes pra caber nela.

**4 · Proporção** — 9:16 pra Reels/TikTok, 16:9 pra YouTube. 0.6 MP é rápido; suba pra 1.0 MP na versão final.

**Fotos** — use os slots **na ordem**: Picture 1, depois 2, 3, 4. Pra usar a 3 ou a 4, selecione o node e aperte **Ctrl+B**. Pra usar menos fotos, desligue (Ctrl+B) as últimas, nunca uma do meio.

**Voz** — suba um áudio curto da voz (5 a 15 s) no **Audio 1**, ligue com Ctrl+B e escreva na ideia "use a minha voz do áudio".

**Resultado** — o vídeo sai em output/video. O prompt usado aparece no quadro verde: gostou de quase tudo? Copie, desligue o enhancer, cole no campo 1 e ajuste à mão.

**Outra versão** — mudar o seed do vídeo (RandomNoise) refaz só o vídeo com o mesmo prompt. Mudar o seed do Enhancer gera um prompt novo.

widgets_values:
REFERENCE ROLES
@Image1: Original white Fiat Uno WITHOUT vinyl, showing four authentic views: two opposite sides, front and rear.
@Image2: Same Fiat Uno WITH the completed black and orange Solar Atacado advertising wrap, in four authentic views.
@Image3: Supplementary graphic-detail reference, restricted to artwork already present on @Image2.
@Image4: Five-frame storyboard 04, defining the camera sequence.
@Image5: Exact shooting environment reference, defining architecture, lighting, floor and background.

SCENE
Professional dynamic automotive advertising film, vertical 9:16, 10 seconds.

The original white Fiat Uno remains parked. The camera moves professionally around the vehicle. Keep the same model, proportions, wheels, windows, headlights and body color throughout.

SHOT PLAN
SHOT 1 | 0.0-1.5s
Complete frontal view of the UNWRAPPED white Fiat Uno, matching the upper-right panel of @Image1. Brief cinematic push-in. Entire front visible. Completely clean white hood.

SHOT 2 | 1.5-3.0s
Hard cut to the UNWRAPPED side shown in the upper-left panel of @Image1, vehicle nose pointing screen right. Full side visible, short lateral tracking movement.

SHOT 3 | 3.0-4.8s
Hard cut to the original UNWRAPPED rear shown in the lower-right panel of @Image1. Brief dolly movement, maintaining the complete rear, original clear rear window and unwrapped tailgate.

SHOT 4 | 4.8-7.0s
Hard cut to the opposite UNWRAPPED side shown in the lower-left panel of @Image1, vehicle nose pointing screen left. Full vehicle visible during a smooth short tracking movement. All body panels remain unwrapped.

SHOT 5 | 7.0-10.0s
INSTANT DIRECT HARD CUT to the SAME vehicle ALREADY COMPLETELY WRAPPED, matching the authentic side shown in the upper-left panel of @Image2.

The finished black and orange graphics, Solar Atacado branding, electric motorcycle images, contact information and original printed design are already fully installed in the very first frame after the cut.

Show a professional full-vehicle advertising shot with a restrained cinematic camera movement.

VISUAL FIDELITY
No vinyl installation.
No appearing, growing, sliding or fading graphics.
No morphing between vehicle states.
No special visual transition effects.

Keep the original paint, vehicle geometry, all graphics and their correct physical positions. Never mirror either side. The actual side artworks are different and must remain correct.

Do not add advertising to unwrapped panels.
Preserve the exact environment from @Image5.
No added captions, floating logos or synthetic text.

AUDIO
No music, no narration, no dialogue.
